comments.body: Migration ran in production during the Tuesday maintenance window; spot-checked SLA dashboard — null first_response_at on closed triage is now under 20 legacy rows with no public comments.

content.text: Migration ran in production during the Tuesday maintenance window; spot-checked SLA dashboard — null first_response_at on closed triage is now under 20 legacy rows with no public comments.

About 2,300 closed triage tickets from before the first_response_at backfill job are missing that timestamp even though they have a clear first public agent comment. SLA reporting excludes them or treats them as never-responded.

Done when a one-shot migration sets first_response_at from the earliest public agent comment for closed tickets where the column is null, writes a dry-run report of row counts per week, and leaves open tickets untouched for the live writer path. Include a reversible backup table triage_first_response_backfill_2026q2.
